"""Disposable actual public trace caller controls on unchanged importer069."""
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import subprocess
import sys
import traceback

ROOT = Path('<local-checkout>')
ASSETS = Path('native-jax-trace-eval-native-control-assets')
ASSETS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for directory in sorted((ROOT / 'lib').glob('*/src'), reverse=True):
    sys.path.insert(0, str(directory))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
for name in tuple(os.environ):
    if name.startswith('IRIS_'):
        os.environ.pop(name)
os.environ['MARIN_PREFIX'] = str(ASSETS / 'marin-prefix')

import jax
import haliax as hax
import levanter
import marin
import iris
import fray
import zephyr
assert jax.default_backend() == 'cpu' and jax.device_count() == 1
assert all(device.platform == 'cpu' for device in jax.devices())
modules = {module.__name__: module.__file__ for module in [levanter,hax,marin,iris,fray,zephyr]}
assert all(str(ROOT) in path for path in modules.values()), modules
print(json.dumps({'actual_device_count':jax.device_count(),'backend':jax.default_backend(),'source_modules':modules}), flush=True)

if sys.argv[1] == 'fixture-tests':
    import pytest
    raise SystemExit(pytest.main(['-c',str(ROOT/'pyproject.toml'),str(ROOT/'tests/evals/test_trace_labeled_eval.py'),'-n','0','-q','--tb=short','--junitxml=native-jax-trace-eval-native-control-fixtures.xml']))

import jmp
import numpy as np
from fray.current_client import set_current_client
from fray.local_backend import LocalClient
from iris.runtime.telemetry import resolve
from levanter.checkpoint import save_checkpoint
from levanter.data.text.datasets import UrlDatasetSourceConfig
from levanter.data.text.trace_chat import TraceChatEvaluationFormat
from levanter.distributed import DistributedConfig
from levanter.model_loading import load_hf_checkpoint, load_levanter_checkpoint
from levanter.models.llama import LlamaConfig
from levanter.models.llama_native_lm import NativeLlamaLmConfig, native_llama_sharding
from levanter.testing.hf_checkpoints import write_llama_checkpoint
from levanter.tokenizers import load_tokenizer
from levanter.tracker import NoopConfig
from levanter.trainer import TrainerConfig
from marin.datakit.chat_template import MARIN_CHAT_TEMPLATE
from marin.evaluation.trace_labeled_eval import DEFAULT_OUTCOME_JUDGE_PROMPT, TraceLabeledEvalConfig, TraceLabeledEvalDatasetConfig, TraceRowAdapterConfig, trace_labeled_eval

assert resolve() is None, 'No Iris publishing runtime is permitted'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip() == '06941a509aabad0830c32ce1689daecaccfe3cdb'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()

fixture = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT/'tests/evals/test_trace_labeled_eval.py'))
tokenizer_path = ASSETS/'tokenizer'
tokenizer_path.mkdir()
fixture['_write_local_tokenizer'](tokenizer_path, [
    'You are a coding agent.', 'Fix the bug.', 'I will inspect the repo.', 'Need to inspect failing tests.',
    'Final Patch:\ndiff --git a/a.py b/a.py', DEFAULT_OUTCOME_JUDGE_PROMPT, 'INCORRECT', 'INCORRECT<|eot_id|>',
])
tokenizer = load_tokenizer(str(tokenizer_path))
row = {'trajectory':[
    {'role':'system','system_prompt':'You are a coding agent.'},
    {'role':'user','content':[{'type':'text','text':'Fix the bug.'}]},
    {'role':'ai','text':'I will inspect the repo.','thinking':'Need to inspect failing tests.'},
], 'test_result':{'git_patch':'diff --git a/a.py b/a.py'}, 'resolved':False}
rows_path=ASSETS/'traces.jsonl'; rows_path.write_text(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
trace_format=TraceChatEvaluationFormat(messages_field='messages',chat_template=MARIN_CHAT_TEMPLATE,loss_tags=('patch','outcome'))
dataset=TraceLabeledEvalDatasetConfig(source=UrlDatasetSourceConfig(train_urls=[str(rows_path)]),split='train',trace_format=trace_format,row_adapter=TraceRowAdapterConfig(input_messages_field='trajectory',patch_field='test_result.git_patch',outcome_field='resolved'))
named_config=LlamaConfig(hidden_dim=16,intermediate_dim=24,num_layers=1,num_heads=2,num_kv_heads=2,max_seq_len=256,attn_backend='vanilla')
source_vocab=len(tokenizer)+1
source=write_llama_checkpoint(ASSETS/'hf-source',named_config,named_config.to_hf_config(source_vocab),key=jax.random.PRNGKey(13))
trainer=TrainerConfig(mp=jmp.get_policy('f32'),train_batch_size=1,per_device_eval_parallelism=1,tracker=NoopConfig(),require_accelerator=False,distributed=DistributedConfig(initialize_jax_distributed=False),shutdown_at_exit=False,log_dir=ASSETS/'logs',id='trace-control',log_jaxprs=False,log_xla_hlo=False)

def bounded_error(exc):
    return {'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc)[:1000],'frames':[{'file':frame.filename,'line':frame.lineno,'function':frame.name} for frame in traceback.extract_tb(exc.__traceback__)]}

def config_for(model,path,is_hf,name,selected_trainer):
    return TraceLabeledEvalConfig(name=name,checkpoint_path=str(path),checkpoint_is_hf=is_hf,tokenizer=str(tokenizer_path),model=model,datasets={'tiny':dataset},trainer=selected_trainer,max_eval_length=256,output_path=str(ASSETS/name),dataset_eval_max_attempts=1)

record={'source_head':'06941a509aabad0830c32ce1689daecaccfe3cdb','source_tree':'63f2fd7a1299b48c0faceaad6de348e0e4b702c7','source_root':str(ROOT),'device_count':jax.device_count(),'backend':jax.default_backend(),'jax_version':jax.__version__,'modules':modules,'precision':'f32 explicitly selected for disposable correctness control; no default modified','tokenizer_vocab':len(tokenizer),'source_vocab':source_vocab,'source_config':dataclasses.asdict(named_config),'asset_root':str(ASSETS),'named':None,'native':[],'local_backend':'real Fray LocalClient / in-process cache workers; no remote job or fake'}
# Config contains enums and nested dataclasses; the exact git source and public scalar geometry are sufficient.
record['source_config']={'hidden_dim':16,'intermediate_dim':24,'num_layers':1,'num_heads':2,'num_kv_heads':2,'max_seq_len':256,'vocab_size':source_vocab}
client=LocalClient(max_threads=4)
try:
    with set_current_client(client):
        try:
            trace_labeled_eval(config_for(named_config,source.path,True,'named-public',trainer))
            named_results=json.loads((ASSETS/'named-public/results.json').read_text())
            metrics=named_results['datasets']['tiny']['metrics']
            assert named_results['status']=='completed'
            for label in ['patch','outcome']:
                assert metrics[f'trace_labeled_eval/tiny/{label}/tokens']>0
                assert math.isfinite(metrics[f'trace_labeled_eval/tiny/{label}/loss'])
            record['named']={'status':'PASSED','results_status':named_results['status'],'completed_datasets':named_results['completed_datasets'],'metrics':metrics}
        except Exception as exc:
            record['named']={'status':'FAILED','error':bounded_error(exc)}
        if record['named']['status']=='PASSED':
            native_config=NativeLlamaLmConfig(**{field.name:getattr(named_config,field.name) for field in dataclasses.fields(named_config)})
            native_trainer=dataclasses.replace(trainer,use_explicit_mesh_axes=True)
            checkpoint=ASSETS/'native-checkpoint'
            with native_trainer.use_device_mesh():
                layout=native_llama_sharding(native_trainer.parameter_axis_mapping,native_trainer.compute_axis_mapping,native_trainer.batch_axis_name)
                native=native_config.build(hax.Axis('vocab',source_vocab),key=jax.random.PRNGKey(0),sharding=layout).from_state_dict(source.weights)
                save_checkpoint({'model':native},0,str(checkpoint),is_temporary=False,metadata=native.checkpoint_metadata())
                roles=dict(axis_mapping=native_trainer.parameter_axis_mapping,compute_axis_mapping=native_trainer.compute_axis_mapping,batch_axis_name=native_trainer.batch_axis_name)
                restored=[load_hf_checkpoint(native_config,str(source.path),tokenizer=tokenizer,compute_dtype=native_trainer.mp.compute_dtype,**roles),load_levanter_checkpoint(native_config,str(checkpoint),Vocab=hax.Axis('vocab',len(tokenizer)),key=jax.random.PRNGKey(1),**roles)]
                for model in restored:
                    assert model.Vocab.size==source_vocab
                    actual=model.to_state_dict()
                    assert actual.keys()==source.weights.keys()
                    for name in actual:
                        assert np.array_equal(np.asarray(actual[name]),np.asarray(source.weights[name])), 'Exact source weight mismatch: '+name
            record['asset_validation']='Both native shared loaders restored exact named source weights and complete vocabulary under explicit roles'
            for route,path,is_hf in [('native-hf',source.path,True),('native-local',checkpoint,False)]:
                result={'route':route,'already_explicit_trainer':True}
                try:
                    trace_labeled_eval(config_for(native_config,path,is_hf,route,native_trainer))
                    result['status']='UNEXPECTED_PASS'
                except Exception as exc:
                    result.update(status='FAILED_AS_EXPECTED' if type(exc) is ValueError and str(exc)=='Loading llama_native requires compute_axis_mapping' else 'OTHER_FAILURE',error=bounded_error(exc))
                result['results_exists']=(ASSETS/route/'results.json').exists()
                record['native'].append(result)
finally:
    client.shutdown()

files=['lib/marin/src/marin/evaluation/model_loading.py','lib/marin/src/marin/evaluation/trace_labeled_eval.py','lib/levanter/src/levanter/model_loading.py','lib/levanter/src/levanter/eval.py','tests/evals/test_trace_labeled_eval.py','lib/levanter/src/levanter/testing/hf_checkpoints.py']
record['source_sha256']={name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files}
record['asset_sha256']={str(path.relative_to(ASSETS)):hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in [tokenizer_path/'tokenizer.json',tokenizer_path/'tokenizer_config.json',rows_path,source.path/'config.json',source.path/'model.safetensors']}
record['source_clean_after']=not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
assert record['source_clean_after']
Path('native-jax-trace-eval-native-control-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'named':record['named'],'native':[{'route':item['route'],'status':item['status'],'exception':item.get('error',{}).get('message'),'results_exists':item['results_exists']} for item in record['native']],'source_clean':record['source_clean_after']},indent=2),flush=True)
